description: Spatio-Temporal Modelling of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kaoutar Bouaachra, Yannig Goude (École Polytechnique). Description This repository contains the datasets supporting the research paper: "Spatio-Temporal Modelling of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand" The data provided here enables the replication of the spatio-temporal analysis and demand forecasting models presented in the study. Datasets The data is organized into the following subfolders for clarity: Sessions_from_ChargePlaceScotland: Standardized Excel files prepared for preprocessing. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
